selection_policy_zh: 只安装最近一周仍活跃、仓库星标/可信来源较强、包含真实 SKILL.md、且和现有库互补的子 skill；聚合目录只进入观察雷达。
selection_policy_en: Install only recently active, reputable repositories with real SKILL.md files and complementary coverage; keep aggregators on the watchlist.

groups.why_zh: 补齐 AST 结构化搜索能力，用于查找 grep 很难表达的代码模式。
groups.why_en: Adds AST-aware structural search for code patterns that plain grep cannot express well.

groups.why_zh: 官方 Supabase 任务指南，覆盖 Auth/RLS/Edge Functions 与 Postgres 性能安全坑。
groups.why_en: Official Supabase task guidance covering Auth, RLS, Edge Functions, and Postgres performance/security traps.

groups.why_zh: 补齐部署、Vercel 优化、React/Next 性能与 Web UI 审查的官方工程实践。
groups.why_en: Adds official deployment, Vercel optimization, React/Next performance, and web UI review practices.

groups.why_zh: 精选工程方法论子集，补强 context/spec/source-driven、API 边界、性能、可观测性、安全和发布门禁。
groups.why_en: Curated engineering-methodology subset for context/spec/source-driven work, API boundaries, performance, observability, security, and launch gates.

groups.why_zh: 补齐 Obsidian Markdown 与 JSON Canvas 这类知识库/画布文件格式能力。
groups.why_en: Adds Obsidian Markdown and JSON Canvas file-format support for knowledge-base and canvas work.

radar.decision_zh: 1000+ agent skills 聚合目录，适合发现趋势；不整包安装。
radar.decision_en: A 1000+ skill aggregator for discovery; not bulk-installed.

radar.decision_zh: 官方基础包已部分覆盖，后续按缺口选择性补装。
radar.decision_en: Official base pack is partially covered already; install selectively by gap.

radar.decision_zh: 包含 reddit-fetch / review-claudemd 等实用点状 skill，暂作后续补齐候选。
radar.decision_en: Contains focused utilities such as reddit-fetch and review-claudemd; kept as a later candidate.

radar.decision_zh: 大型 installable library，需 dry-scan 后按主题分批筛选。
radar.decision_en: Large installable library; requires dry-scan and topic-based curation.
